listing.title: They Said It Couldn't Be Built — The Impossible Stones
listing.description:
For two thousand years people have looked at megalithic stone and concluded that someone else must have built it. Pausanias blamed one-eyed giants.
The argument has never gone out of use. It has only changed its builder.
This is what the evidence actually says — and the four places it genuinely runs out.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Cold open
00:45 A verdict two thousand years old
04:54 Where the stones came from
09:29 The hole in the granite
15:23 The cases nobody has closed
19:56 Outro

IMAGE AND FOOTAGE CREDITS
This film is built from 54 freely licensed photographs and clips. 29 of them are share-alike (CC BY-SA), and the film is offered under the same terms where those shots appear.
Every credit — creator, licence and source URL — is in the pinned comment, because the full list is longer than a YouTube description may be.

Narration is synthesised speech. Graphics are original.

New video every Monday.
